name: AI Stack Decision Playbook 📚
description_md:
# What You Get

- A full-stack framework to evaluate, test, and pick the right AI tools with eight gates of decision-making, from step-change analysis to economic reality checks.

- Worksheets, scorecards, and one-page checklists that turn hype into hard numbers—so you can kill subscription creep and vendor FOMO before it drains your budget.

- Real-world case studies and pilot templates that show you how to cut through noise, spot red flags, and build a lean, resilient AI stack.

Join the Early AI-dopters Community — you won’t regret it 😉
